arxiv-2108-13151.title: Solving the puzzle of high temperature light (anti)-nuclei production in ultra-relativistic heavy ion collisions
arxiv-2108-13151.creator: Tim Neidig, Kai Gallmeister, Carsten Greiner, Marcus Bleicher, Volodymyr Vovchenko
arxiv-2108-13151.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tim Neidig, Kai Gallmeister, Carsten Greiner, Marcus Bleicher, Volodymyr Vovchenko. The creation of loosely bound objects in heavy ion collisions, e.g. light clusters, near the phase transition temperature ( T ch ≈ 155 ​ MeV T_{\rm ch}\approx 155\,{\rm MeV} ) has been a puzzling observation that seems to be at odds with Big Bang nucleosynthesis suggesting that deuterons and other clusters are formed only below a temperature T ≈ 0.1 − 1 ​ MeV T\approx 0.1-1\,{\rm MeV} .

arxiv-2212-12532.title: Generalization Bounds for Few-Shot Transfer Learning with Pretrained Classifiers
arxiv-2212-12532.creator: Tomer Galanti galanti@mit.edu, András György agyorgy@google.com, Marcus Hutter mhutter@google.com
arxiv-2212-12532.description: Abstract We study the ability of foundation models to learn representations for classification that are transferable to new, unseen classes. Recent results in the literature show that representations learned by a single classifier over many classes are competitive on few-shot learning problems with representations learned by special-purpose algorithms designed for such problems.

arxiv-2305-08651.title: Methodological considerations for novel approaches to covariate-adjusted indirect treatment comparisons Publication type: Discussion
arxiv-2305-08651.creator: Antonio Remiro-Azócar, Anna Heath, Gianluca Baio
arxiv-2305-08651.description: Abstract We examine four important considerations in the development of covariate adjustment methodologies for indirect treatment comparisons. Firstly, we consider potential advantages of weighting versus outcome modeling, placing focus on bias-robustness. Secondly, we outline why model-based extrapolation may be required and useful, in the specific context of indirect treatment comparisons with limited overlap.

arxiv-2310-16553.title: Anharmonicity and structural phase transition in the Mott insulator Cu 2 P 2 O 7
arxiv-2310-16553.creator: Svitlana Pastukh, Paweł T. Jochym, Oleksandr Pastukh, Jan Łażewski, Dominik Legut, Przemysław Piekarz
arxiv-2310-16553.description: Abstract Ab initio investigations of structural, electronic, and dynamical properties of the high-temperature β \beta phase of copper pyrophosphate were performed using density functional theory. The electronic band structure shows the Mott insulating state due to electron correlations in copper ions.

arxiv-2403-05558.title: Ethical and Privacy Considerations with Location Based Data Research DOI: 123X567.123X567 Conference: ACM Internet Measurement Conference; February 30, 1999; World Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/22/10
arxiv-2403-05558.creator: Leonardo Tonetto, Pauline Kister, Nitinder Mohan, Jörg Ott
arxiv-2403-05558.description: Abstract . Networking research, especially focusing on human mobility, has evolved significantly in the last two decades and now relies on collection and analyzing larger datasets. The increasing sizes of datasets are enabled by larger automated efforts to collect data as well as by scalable methods to analyze and unveil insights, which was not possible many years ago.

arxiv-2405-20944.title: Two-dimensional solitons in second-harmonic-generating media with fractional diffraction
arxiv-2405-20944.creator: Hidetsugi Sakaguchi 1 and Boris A. Malomed 2,3
arxiv-2405-20944.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hidetsugi Sakaguchi 1 and Boris A. Malomed 2,3. We introduce a system of propagation equations for the fundamental-frequency (FF) and second-harmonic (SH) waves in the bulk waveguide with the effective fractional diffraction and quadratic ( χ ( 2 ) \chi^{(2)} ) nonlinearity. The numerical solution produces families of ground-state (zero-vorticity) two-dimensional solitons in the free space, which are stable in exact agreement with the Vakhitov-Kolokolov criterion, while vortex solitons are completely unstable in that case.

arxiv-2411-19143.title: Co-Learning: Towards Semi-Supervised Object Detection with Road-side Cameras
arxiv-2411-19143.creator: Jicheng Yuan, Anh Le-Tuan, Ali Ganbarov, Manfred Hauswirth, Danh Le-Phuoc
arxiv-2411-19143.description: Abstract Recently, deep learning has experienced rapid expansion, contributing significantly to the progress of supervised learning methodologies. However, acquiring labeled data in real-world settings can be costly, labor-intensive, and sometimes scarce. This challenge inhibits the extensive use of neural networks for practical tasks due to the impractical nature of labeling vast datasets for every individual application.

arxiv-2602-12265.title: Holographic Equidistribution
arxiv-2602-12265.creator: Nico Cooper
arxiv-2602-12265.description: Abstract Hecke operators acting on modular functions arise naturally in the context of 2d conformal field theory, but in seemingly disparate areas, including permutation orbifold theories, ensembles of code CFTs, and more recently in the context of the AdS 3 /RMT 2 program.

pmc-10594710.title: Exploring the health consequences of armed conflict: the perspective of Northeast Ethiopia, 2022: a qualitative study
pmc-10594710.creator: Mulugeta Wodaje Arage, Henok Kumsa, Mulu Shiferaw Asfaw, Abebe Tarekegn Kassaw, Ephrem Mebratu Dagnew, Abayneh Tunta, Woldeteklehymanot Kassahun, Amanuel Addisu, Molla Yigzaw, Tilahun Hailu, Lebeza Alemu Tenaw
pmc-10594710.description: BackgroundConflict is a complicated topic with a multidimensional consequences for community health. Its effects have a broad pattern, starting from direct war-related morbidity and mortality caused by bullets and bombs to indirect consequences due to the interruption of the delivery of preventive and curative health services.

pmc-10624903.title: Machine learning-based prediction models for parathyroid carcinoma using pre-surgery cognitive function and clinical features
pmc-10624903.creator: Yuting Wang, Bojun Wei, Teng Zhao, Hong Shen, Xing Liu, Jiacheng Wang, Qian Wang, Rongfang Shen, Dalin Feng
pmc-10624903.description: Patients with parathyroid carcinoma (PC) are often diagnosed postoperatively, due to incomplete resection during the initial surgery, resulting in poor outcomes. The aim of our study was to investigate the pre-surgery indicators of PC and try to develop a predictive model for PC utilizing machine learning.

pmc-10631732.title: Emergence and inversion of chirality in hierarchical assemblies of CdS nanocrystal fibers
pmc-10631732.creator: Alexander V. Gonzalez, Miranda Gonzalez, Tobias Hanrath
pmc-10631732.description: Arranging semiconducting nanocrystals into ordered superstructures is a promising platform to study fundamental light-matter interactions and develop programmable optical metamaterials. We investigated how the geometrical arrangement of CdS nanocrystals in hierarchical assemblies affects chiroptical properties. To create these structures, we controlled the evaporation of a colloidal CdS nanocrystal solution between two parallel plates.

pmc-10882202.title: ‘Nothing About Us Without Us’: exploring benefits and challenges of peer support for people with disability in peer support organisations – protocol paper for a qualitative coproduction project
pmc-10882202.creator: Julie Duong, Shaylie Pryer, Catherine Walsh, Arron Fitzpatrick, Julie Magill, Sarah Simmonds, David Yang, Owen Baird-Peddie, Farhana Rahman, Carrie Hayter, Meredith Tavener
pmc-10882202.description: IntroductionOne in six people live with disability in Australia with higher levels of disability of people from diverse communities, such as those with culturally and linguistically diverse (CALD) backgrounds. In Australia, CALD refers to people from diverse ethnicity and cultures, nationalities, societal structures and religions that may or may not speak a language other than English.

pmc-11712614.title: Alzheimer’s disease drug discovery centering on Hyperphosphorylated tau
pmc-11712614.creator: Kuang‐Wei Wang
pmc-11712614.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s Disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the accumulation of neurofibrillary tangles (NFTs) which consist primarily of hyperphosphorylated tau protein. Abnormal phosphorylated tau has been considered as a pathogenic species that impairs cellular function and propagates from neuron to neuron.

pmc-12607201.title: Prehabilitation for patients undergoing endoscopic submucosal dissection: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12607201.creator: Biyun Jiang, Shengdi Lu, Yiling Yan, Ruixin Wang, Manrong Xu, Lihua Huang, Yun Shen
pmc-12607201.description: BackgroundEndoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is a minimally invasive therapy for early gastrointestinal neoplasms, but patients may experience reduced functional capacity and delayed recovery post-procedure. Prehabilitation, has shown benefits in major surgery by improving physical fitness and recovery. We hypothesized that a structured prehabilitation regimen before ESD would enhance postoperative functional recovery and patient outcomes compared to standard care.

pmc-12975344.title: Mid-term Outcomes Following Primary Covered Stent Implantation in Supra-Aortic Arch Vessels for Atherosclerotic Occlusive Disease
pmc-12975344.creator: Georgios Sachsamanis, Piotr M Kasprzak, Wilma Schierling, Milena Pavlovic, Evgenia Zygouridou, Karin Pfister
pmc-12975344.description: PurposeThe aim of this study was to present the mid-term outcomes of patients undergoing treatment for atherosclerotic stenosis or occlusion of the supra-aortic arch vessels using covered stents.Materials and MethodsWe conducted a retrospective, single-center analysis of patients treated for supra-aortic arch vessel atherosclerotic occlusive disease (AOD) at our institution between 2015 and 2024.

pmc-13182534.title: HDAC7-Induced Epigenetic Repression Modulates ATF3 Functional Plasticity in Colorectal Cancer Pathogenesis
pmc-13182534.creator: Qi Wang, Donglei Ji, Yanjie Jia, Shuang Li, Wenjing Gao, Tingting Liang, Yingying Liang, Caroline Zeng, Chunyu Wang, Ka Lung Cheung, Quan Wang, Ming-Ming Zhou, Lei Zeng
pmc-13182534.description: Class IIa histone deacetylase 7 (HDAC7) regulates transcription primarily through scaffolding functions, but its molecular mechanisms in cancer pathogenesis remain incompletely understood. Here, we establish HDAC7 as a key epigenetic regulator in colorectal cancer (CRC). HDAC7 is overexpressed in CRC tumors and correlates with advanced disease stages, lymph node metastasis, and poor patient survival.

pmc-13360266.title: Two genes, one switch: a bidirectional promoter strategy for inducible plant immunity
pmc-13360266.creator: Benjamin J M Tremblay
pmc-13360266.description: activated, plants are often better protected against pathogens; however, the price for this protection is reduced growth or fitness. This defense-growth tradeoff has therefore become a major obstacle to engineering disease resistance in crops (Han et al. 2024). Plants rely on a multilayered immune system to detect and respond to infection (Jones and Dangl 2006).

pmc-13633250.title: The long non-coding RNA-encoded microprotein MKKS3 drives colorectal cancer chemoresistance
pmc-13633250.creator: Hui-Fang Hu, Qi Zhou, Jia-Zhen Huang, Jia-Ying Fu, Zhi-Ting Zuo, Qing-Yu He
pmc-13633250.description: Although oxaliplatin is widely used in the frontline treatment of colorectal cancer (CRC), CRC recurrence is commonly observed owing to oxaliplatin resistance. The roles of long non-coding RNAs-encoded microproteins in oxaliplatin chemoresistance remain inadequately explored. In this study, a CRISPR/Cas9 library was developed to target previously identified 314 microproteins translated from long non-coding RNAs, followed by functional screening.

pmc-13654132.title: The added value of contrast-enhanced ultrasonography to BI-RADS in the evaluation of breast lesions presenting with pathological nipple discharge
pmc-13654132.creator: Jiaqian Zhong, Jia Luo, Shaohong Wu, Manying Li, Jinyu Liang, Fushun Pan, Xiaoyan Xie, Yanling Zheng
pmc-13654132.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPathological nipple discharge (PND) is a frequent presentation in breast clinics, yet its accurate differentiation between benign and malignant lesions remains difficult due to the inherent limitations of current imaging tools. There is still a lack of a practical, non‑invasive approach that incorporates contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) features with the conventional Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) to improve the diagnostic yield.

uslaw-usc-t25-s14a.title: 25 U.S.C. § 14a — Deposit of grant funds received by Bureau from other Federal agencies
uslaw-usc-t25-s14a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s14a.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 1 (Bureau Of Indian Affairs). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. On and after October 12, 1984, moneys received by grant to the Bureau of Indian Affairs from other Federal agencies to carry out various programs for elementary and secondary education, handicapped programs, bilingual education, and other specific programs shall be deposited into the appropriation account.
